results.body: 我还没决定具体出发日，想先排一下英国旅游签证的时间。最早能提前多久递交？正常情况下，从申请到有结果一般要等多久？
results.original_provider_bound_body:
如果你需要申请 Standard Visitor，最早可在出发前 3 个月申请。在线申请、身份核验和材料提交都完成后，通常在 3 周内收到决定；不是从开始准备材料那天起算，也不保证按时出结果或一定获批。这说的是签证决定时间，不是护照返还日期。
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa

results.body: 关于英国访客签证要用的银行流水，我不太清楚应该准备哪几个月的记录。银行手机应用里下载的对账单可以用吗，还是需要去柜台拿？
results.original_provider_bound_body:
如果是普通 Standard Visitor 申请，这份官方材料指南没有统一规定银行流水必须提供几个月。重点是说明资金来源、你确实可以使用这些资金，并结合这次旅行的支出核对是否充足；我不能只凭流水覆盖的月份判断材料是否足够。
获取方面，可以先在网银或银行 App 里找正式电子对账单；没有下载入口的话，向银行索取。这是收集材料的办法，不代表任何下载文件都会被接受。拿到后还要核对账户持有人、交易记录、资金来源和可用资金；不要只发一个余额截图来代替完整说明。
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances

results.body: 我打算开始整理英国旅游签证的资料了。请按我这个在香港递交、自己出钱的中国籍学生情况，列一份申请前要准备的材料清单，方便我逐项核对。
results.original_provider_bound_body:
接下来还需要这些材料；有哪份暂时拿不到，也可以直接告诉我：
- 有效护照或旅行证件 — 核对身份，以及有效期是否覆盖整个计划停留期间
- 在读证明 — 可向学校索取抬头纸证明，说明在读及准假情况，用来支持你的学习情况说明
- 访问目的的证明材料 — 说明这次去做什么；旅游可以先整理真实的计划行程，不把未定安排写成已预订
- 可用资金及来源证明，例如银行流水 — 说明谁承担费用、资金从哪里来，以及你是否能使用这些钱；预算金额本身不是证明
- 在申请所在地合法居留的证明 — 说明你在递交申请的国家或地区的合法居留身份

这是按你的情况列出的待补材料，不是所有申请人通用的强制清单。如果行程或资助情况有变化，我会再调整。

GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk

results.body: I'm trying to work out when to start my UK visitor visa application. How far before travel can I apply, and how long does a normal decision take? Also, must I already have paid for my flights and hotel when I apply? I haven't chosen dates yet.
results.original_provider_bound_body:
For an ordinary Standard Visitor application, you do not need to buy flights or book a hotel just to supply booking evidence. The official guide describes hotel bookings and flight bookings (except transit) as less useful evidence. We can first record your intended arrangements without describing unbooked plans as confirmed bookings.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#documents-you-should-not-use-as-evidence

If you need a Standard Visitor visa, you can apply up to 3 months before travel. A decision usually takes up to 3 weeks after you have applied online, proved your identity and provided your documents—not from the day you start preparing. This is not a guaranteed deadline or a promise of approval. That is decision timing, not a passport-return date.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa

results.body: For the financial evidence in my UK visitor application, my own savings are split between a current account and a savings account. What bank records should show that I can actually access the money for the trip? I'm only asking about evidence of access to those funds.
results.original_provider_bound_body:
For an ordinary Standard Visitor application, this official document guide does not set one fixed number of months of bank statements for everyone. The focus is where the funds come from, whether you can access them and how they relate to the trip's costs. The number of months alone does not establish whether the evidence is sufficient.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances

customer_answers:
Start with official statements for the relevant accounts showing the account holder, where the funds come from and the transactions. They also need to explain whether you can access the money for the trip; a balance alone does not explain all of that. If using money from different accounts, keep separate statements for each account and explain transfers between them so the same money is not counted twice. If any savings have withdrawal restrictions, check their availability with the bank. These are preparation suggestions; the actual records still need checking.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances

results.body: Before I start collecting things for the UK tourist visit, can you lay out the documents I need to prepare? I'm a Chinese student applying in Hong Kong and paying for the trip myself. A checklist would help.
results.original_provider_bound_body:
We'll also need these documents. Let me know if any are difficult to obtain:
- Valid passport or travel document — to check your identity and validity throughout the planned stay
- Evidence of your student status — ask your school for a headed letter confirming enrolment and leave, to support your stated study circumstances
- Evidence of the purpose of the visit — to explain what you will do; for a holiday, outline your real plans without presenting unbooked arrangements as bookings
- Evidence of available funds and their source, such as bank statements — to show who pays, where the money comes from and access to it; a budget figure alone is not evidence
- Evidence of legal residence when applying outside the country of nationality — to show your lawful residence where you are applying

This is a preparation list for your circumstances, not a universal mandatory checklist. I'll adjust it if your travel or funding arrangements change.

GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa
